structure.unit: Highways and Other Surface Transportation Systems
Modes of Transportation: Highways, Bridges, Ferries, Rail, and Public Transportation
Outdoor Advertising in Sight of Public Highways

law.catch_line: Identification of advertising structure or advertisement
law.text: The Commissioner of Highways shall require that each advertising structure and each advertisement not posted or displayed on an advertising structure bear an identification number furnished by the Commissioner of Highways and, if erected, maintained, or displayed by a permitted outdoor advertiser, also bear its name. The Commissioner of Highways shall make suitable provisions for the details thereof.
